name: neko-cli
description: Neko-CLI is an innovative Node.js package manager offering advanced installation (add, all), publishing (publish to custom registries), a development server with hot-reloading (flush), and enhanced dependency management via a custom lockfile (deps.neko), distinguishing itself by integrating AI-powered tools like ai-code-review-dep for intelligent code analysis focusing on dependency usage, aiming to optimize code and improve project maintainability.

scripts.test: echo "$(node -e 'require("chalk").yellow("🐾 Running test suite...")')" && echo "$(node -e 'require("chalk").green("✨ All tests passed! You're awesome!")')"

author: Kael Garau
